gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-momo-trust-displ: Stencil-cut and loud, with wide bridges between the letters. Momo Trust Display follows in a plain sans, its drifting, spaced-out letters giving the pair its strongest quality: a shout up top and room to breathe below.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mukta-malar: Expressive, with stencil bridges and a wide-open sprung-clip curve. Mukta Malar sits underneath in compact sans-serif form, and its short ascenders are the quiet quality that makes the loud heading look even bolder.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-displa: Snowburst One cuts its stencil letters tall and bold, with wide bridges and a generous curve opening above the text. Noto Sans Display reads smoothly.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-roboto-condensed: Bold, stencil-cut letters with wide bridges and tall lowercase. Snowburst One loves a dramatic gap, while Roboto Condensed, a sans-serif with barely visible gaps inside each word, glides along like wire with curves and stems in lockstep.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-tiny5: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet with wide bridges between letters and tall lowercase. Tiny5 is a sans-serif built so tall that its ascenders look short, making it the compact counterpoint.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-space-grotesk: Stencil sheets, wide bridges, tall lowercase: Snowburst One comes in loud. And Space Grotesk, a sans-serif with hollow-reed counters and ribbon-like strokes of constant width, settles the page right back down.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-amulya: Distinctive, with pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase, Tektur cuts its stencil letters at one steady width. And Amulya, a plain sans with generous curve gaps, keeps paragraphs reading smoothly and openly.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-chillax: Tektur brings pipe-cleaner strokes and high, outsized lowercase. Chillax, a sans-serif drawn like spaghetti, with pen-lifted loops left unfinished and a more moderate lowercase height, loosens the page up beneath it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-allerta: Pipe-cleaner strokes, each traced at the width of a single stylus, give Tektur its look. Allerta, a sans-serif with wide, loose tracking and a prominent x-height, would read in a relaxed, open way across paragraphs.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-basic: Tektur's outsized lowercase and pipe-cleaner strokes, each a plain stripe of constant ink, make it unmistakable and expressive. Basic, a sans-serif, reads cleanly.
